proposal.reason: The substantive change is a CI/test-orchestration overhaul: dual-platform (M890P + OAM-810E EIC) workflow matrices, case generation/grouping/reconciliation updates, optional trusted HPN SDK install wiring, shared artifact handling, and expanded CI validation/reporting (including raw/dmesg artifact capture). These are execution and reporting pipeline changes, not runtime PCCL module logic or review-policy automation.
